name: Figure IV-6: carrying capacity with and without trade
description: Figure IV-6: carrying capacity (mean population over ticks 200–300) against mean vision, with and without trade, in the ({G₁}, {M, T}) market of iv-3-trade. A mean of m is the uniform range 1–(2m−1). Seeds 1–10; the book averages 10 runs per point. Measured (release, seeds 1–10): no trade mean population 33.8 at vision 1 and 69.8 at vision 6; trade mean population 41.8 at vision 1 and 76.6 at vision 6. Ticks 300, 500 and 1000 all satisfy the settlement rule for every cell; 300 is the smallest.
